blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: The wrapper implementations establish no direct holder freeze, while upstream yzUSD and reserve-asset access exposure remains inherited.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-verified 2026-08-09 on both deployments. At Plasma block 29369955 the syzUSD proxy 0xc8a8df9b210243c55d31c73090f06787ad0a1bf6 resolves EIP-1967 implementation 0xa3982582016375a0b25cb7d572379d3d49e5e9c8 and admin 0x7392751a860a51694231c7a0b4a9c853f8169cf0, asset() returns yzUSD 0x6695c0f8706c5ace3bdf8995073179cca47926dc, paused() is false, and freeze-family probes such as isBlacklisted(address) revert; that ProxyAdmin's owner() is Safe 0xa2a9700407934e913c840556b3d29f19cf6f203d with getThreshold() 4 and no timelock. At Monad block 94595184 the proxy 0x484be0540ad49f351eaa04eeb35df0f937d4e73f resolves implementation 0xe536b80e7f859e72ad095d769da1da45b7312d53 and admin 0x7040b88de8a8e63b9dffe2250f8062dcc1ca7331, whose owner() is TimelockController 0xd32ab76a165f1a716986ba8c58344e3df4397f5e with getMinDelay() 43200 seconds. The issuer's pinned source documents pause() as scoped to mint and redeem, adds no transfer hook, and blocks rescueTokens on the vault asset while supply is nonzero, so no live holder-selective freeze exists locally; the live proxy admins mean one could be added by upgrade. Backing is the single 100% reserve slice yzusd-yuzu, whose own verdict is possible over issuer-freezable reserve assets, so the named upstream exposure is retained and the verdict stays inherited rather than being collapsed into a token-local possible.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: syzUSD is Yuzu's ERC-4626 staking wrapper over yzUSD: issuer documentation re-read on 2026-07-30 states that staking converts form only, confers no separate rights beyond representing the staked position, and unstaking back to yzUSD completes almost instantly, so the wrapper's live stabilization and claim structure is exactly the parent's. Parent yzusd-yuzu carries a resolved cdp archetype (an overcollateralized on-chain strategy pool with the yzPP junior tranche absorbing first losses), and this variant intentionally does not diverge, so mechanismArchetype is set to cdp and no archetypeOverride is recorded. Classification clears NR eligibility only; it does not assert that the mechanism is safe.

collateral: Staked wrapper over Yuzu USD, backed by yzUSD reserve assets deployed into curated DeFi yield strategies and overcollateralized by protocol risk tranching
pegMechanism: Users stake yzUSD for syzUSD; syzUSD appreciates against yzUSD as strategy yield accrues, and final exits inherit Yuzu's KYC-gated primary redemption and liquidity-buffer constraints

oracleRisk.summary: syzUSD is Yuzu's staking wrapper over yzUSD; its share price accrues strategy yield and the wrapper does not expose a separate borrower collateral market or token-level liquidation oracle.

branchApplicability.rationale: Yuzu documents syzUSD as a technical staking wrapper: users convert yzUSD into syzUSD shares and can unstake back to yzUSD. The reviewed wrapper has no borrower-owned debt positions or separate collateral/liquidation branches; underlying yzUSD mechanics remain a parent-asset dependency.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: syzUSD moves cross-chain between Plasma and Monad via a LayerZero OVault. Yuzu's own audited contracts (ovault/ProtoOVaultComposer and PSMOVaultComposer) inherit LayerZero's VaultComposerSync and wire an asset+share OFT mesh, with the share token (syzUSD) explicitly required to be an OFTAdapter lockbox (approvalRequired()==true) on the hub chain (most likely Plasma) and a standard OFT on spokes. Because the durable supply path for shares runs through a third-party (LayerZero) OFTAdapter lockbox control surface, this is an external lock/mint route rather than opaque. (Named DVN set and a live LayerZeroScan trace were not pinned, and the on-chain hub identity was not confirmed at the explorer/deploy-config level, but the lockbox/adapter requirement is code-enforced in the issuer's audited composer.)

controls.label: Yuzu Plasma ProxyAdmin owner Safe (4-of-5)
controls.evidence: At Plasma block 29275684 on 2026-08-08, the vault ProxyAdmin 0x7392751a860a51694231c7a0b4a9c853f8169cf0 still reported this 4-of-5 Safe as owner. Direct Safe reads returned version 1.4.1, the listed five owners, no enabled modules, zero guard and fallback handler, and master copy 0x29fcb43b46531bca003ddc8fcb67ffe91900c762. The Safe can replace the Plasma vault implementation without a separate on-chain delay.

controls.label: Yuzu Monad ProxyAdmin 12-hour timelock
controls.evidence: At Monad block 94284390 on 2026-08-08, the vault ProxyAdmin 0x7040b88de8a8e63b9dffe2250f8062dcc1ca7331 still returned this contract as owner, and getMinDelay() returned 43,200 seconds. Safe, Ownable, and module probes reverted, while the standard timelock delay selector succeeded. This immediate 12-hour TimelockController is the authority that can replace the Monad wrapper implementation.

review.evidence: syzUSD (variantOf yzusd-yuzu, variantKind strategy-vault) is a serial wrapper over yzUSD: the local share-accounting route cannot create durable parent supply, and yzUSD control is carried by the exact parent dependency. A duplicate local issuer-backend control was removed because it incorrectly made the wrapper look like a second issuer mint path. Fresh reads on 2026-08-08 reconfirmed the Plasma proxy implementation/admin and asset at block 29275787, classified its admin owner as a 4-of-5 Safe with no modules or guard at block 29275684, and reconfirmed the Monad proxy/admin at block 94284684. The previously unclassified Monad ProxyAdmin owner returned getMinDelay() = 43,200 seconds at block 94284390, identifying the immediate upgrade controller as a 12-hour timelock. Plasma vault owner() remains EOA 0xceaff57fbcd0e8f095c5c1125dd09b93fc5bbf82 and Monad owner() remains EOA 0x4ea00dc0c2b3933b9b41c6cc372832fe844a89ae; these operational owners do not create base yzUSD supply.
